description:
Macro Deck transforms your phone, tablet, or any device equipped with a modern internet browser into an efficient remote macro pad. With this tool, you can execute single or multi-step actions seamlessly with just a single tap.


What's Changed
3.0.4 is a bug fix release on top of 3.0.2. It replaces 3.0.3, which was withdrawn shortly after release because it accidentally contained unreleased 3.1 features. Those features will ship with 3.1.
🚀 Improvements
- Use the new Companion and Delegate integration icons by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1764
⚡ Performance
- Keep Host log files small and stop logging every database command by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1800
🐞 Bug Fixes
- Refuse an unsigned plugin file over a verified version before asking for consent by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1766
- Keep the theme chosen in the Web Client after a reload by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1780
- Report corrupt plugin package entries as unreadable in the plugin CLI by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1781
- Fix Music Player artwork staying blank on iOS older than 14 by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1783
- Stop plugins and hosts from failing on NaN or infinite event values by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1785
- Keep the letter case of typed text on Linux while Caps Lock is on by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1787
- Retry a failed weather refresh instead of waiting 15 minutes by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1786
- Release the key that went down when the keyboard layout changes on Windows by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1784
- Keep keys from staying pressed after a keyboard layout switch on Linux by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1789
- Log keyboard input that an app started as administrator blocks on Windows by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1788
- Keep the host running on Linux when its X server goes away by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1792
- Render every plugin tile when a deck opens more than 32 at once by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1797
- Keep a SoundPad connection that a command opened while a retry fails by @manuelmayer-dev in https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/pull/1793
Full Changelog: https://github.com/Macro-Deck-App/Macro-Deck/compare/v3.0.2...v3.0.4
